Reason: The chest X-ray (Figure 5) demonstrates right lower lobe opacity with volume loss and mediastinal shift, consistent with atelectasis; the accompanying CT images reveal a high-density foreign body in the right bronchial tree causing obstruction. This aligns with option B's description of progressive right lower lobe atelectasis due to a foreign body, whereas other options describe pneumonia, asthma, mass, effusion, or normal findings which are inconsistent with the imaging evidence. *(guided by t000002, t000003)*
